description: Comparing power-system- and user-oriented battery electric vehicle charging representation and its implications on energy system modeling is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Niklas Wulff, Felix Steck (German Aerospace Center, Institute of Engineering Thermodynamics, Department of Energy Systems Analysis). This supplementary material includes data and code for the research described in the paper "Comparing power-system- and user-oriented battery electric vehicle charging representation and its implications on energy system modeling". Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
